title: tensor-product
description: The bifunctor ⊗ : C × C → C of a monoidal category, combining two objects into one and two morphisms into one, associative up to coherent isomorphism with the unit object as neutral element. The categorical lift of a monoid's multiplication.

bifunctor.description: ⊗ : C × C → C, functorial in both arguments

monoidal-category.description: the monoidal category whose tensor this is
